svg.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 throughput
svg.desc: Reading and answer-writing speeds of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on the BOSGAME M5 (Ryzen AI Max+ 395, Radeon 8060S, 128 GiB RAM) with two RX 7900 XTX cards, or one. The test asks the model to find five labelled phrases placed in a long text. Every run found all five correctly. Each point measures one request at the input length shown. Each horizontal tick doubles the input length.
